songs.name: Demo arrangement
songs.description: Intro / verse / chorus built on the demo pattern library.

songs.name: Rock 8 Measures
songs.description: 8-measure rock phrase ending with a drum break/fill on measure 8

patterns.name: Rock
patterns.description: Rock, 2 measures: syncopated kick, snare backbeat with ghost fills, 16th closed hats with an open hat on each &; cowbell 8ths every 6 passes, crash every 4.

patterns.name: Rock Ghost Notes
patterns.description: Rock, 1 measure: kick on 1 and 3&, snare backbeat with ghosts on 2a and 3e, 8th hats; snare pickup on 4& 4a every 4 passes, crash every 4.

patterns.name: Rock Alternating
patterns.description: Rock, 1 measure: kick alternating between two figures from pass to pass, snare on 2 and 4, 8th hats; tom pickup every 4 passes, open hat on 4& every 2.

patterns.name: Rock Clap Fill
patterns.description: Rock, 1 measure: kick on 1, 2& and a soft 3, snare on 2 and 4, 8th hats; clap on 3 every 4 passes, 16th clap fill on 4 every 8, cowbell roll every 3.

patterns.name: Rock Basic
patterns.description: Basic rock on an 8th grid, 1 measure: kick on 1, 3 and 3&, snare on 2 and 4, 8th hats with an open hat on 4&; snare pickup on 4& every 4 passes, crash every 4.

patterns.name: Rock Syncopated
patterns.description: Rock, 1 measure: kick on 1, 2& and 3, snare on 2 and 4 with a ghost on 3e, 8th hats; snare pickup on 4& 4a every 4 passes, open hat on 3a every 2.

patterns.name: Breakbeat
patterns.description: Breakbeat, 2 measures: busy syncopated kick, snare on 2 and 4 with 3e, 4& and 4a, 16th hats; open hats every 2 and 3 passes.

patterns.name: Shuffle
patterns.description: Shuffle on a triplet grid, 1 measure: kick on 1 and 3 with a last-triplet pickup, snare on 2 and 4, shuffled closed hats, open hat on each &; triplet snare fills every 4 passes.

patterns.name: Rock Fast
patterns.description: Rock, 1 measure: kick on 1, 1&, 3 and 3a, snare on 2 and 4, 8th hats, open hat on 4&; tom pickup on 4e and 4a every 4 passes.

patterns.name: Rock Polyrhythm
patterns.description: Rock, 1 measure: kick on 1 and 3a, snare on 2 and 4, closed hat on each a, open hat every 3 steps across the beat; 16th tom fill on 4 every 4 and 8 passes, crash every 6.

patterns.name: Disco Toms
patterns.description: Disco, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, 16th closed hats, open hat on each e, tom figure on 1-2 and a tom fill on 4, no snare; clap on 3& and 4 every 2 passes, crashes every 8.

patterns.name: Disco Upbeat
patterns.description: Disco, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, snare on every & with 2a, clap on 2 and 4, closed hats on 1, e and a, open hat on each &; pitched toms on 3-4 every 4 passes.

patterns.name: Disco
patterns.description: Disco, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, snare on 2 and 4, closed hats on 1, e and a, open hat on each &; tom, clap and cowbell figures every 2 to 8 passes.

patterns.name: Batucada
patterns.description: Samba batucada, 1 measure: kick on each beat and its a, snare and clap syncopations over 2 beats, 16th hats with a gap on 2 and 4, open hat on 2 and 4; cowbell pickup on 4 every 4 to 8 passes.

patterns.name: Latin House
patterns.description: Latin house, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, snare on every & with a 4e-&-a run, syncopated clap over 2 beats, open hat on each &; low cowbell roll every 8 passes, pitched crash accents every 4.

patterns.name: Pop
patterns.description: Pop, 1 measure: kick on 1, 2&, 3 and 4&, snare on 2, a soft 4 and 4&, clap on 1, 8th hats.

patterns.name: March
patterns.description: March, 1 measure: kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4 with a 16th roll on 4 building over 4 passes, closed hats around the backbeat, open hats on 1 and 3; 32nd tom figures on 3-4 every 4 to 8 passes.

patterns.name: Polyrhythm Kick
patterns.description: Polyrhythm, 1 measure: kick every 3 steps across the 4/4, snare on 2 and 4, open hat on each beat, syncopated closed hats; 16th clap fill on 4 every 2 passes, cowbell on 2& 2a every 4.

patterns.name: Son Clave
patterns.description: Latin, 1 measure: 3-2 son clave on the clap over a four-on-the-floor kick, snare on 1&, 1a, 3e and 3&, closed hat on each &; pitched 16th toms on 4 every 6 passes.

patterns.name: Salsa
patterns.description: Salsa, 1 measure: congas and low congas in a tumbao, syncopated snare and cowbell, 16th tambourine, open hat pairs, kick on 1, 2&, 3 and 4&, mono bass on 1, 1a, 2&, 3, 3a and 4&.

patterns.name: Bossa Nova
patterns.description: Bossa nova, 1 measure: kick on 1, 2& and 3, snare on 2, 3& and 4&, cowbell on 1, 2&, 3 and 4, 8th hats, toms on 3& and 4&; 16th tom pickup on 1 every 4 passes.

patterns.name: Stomp
patterns.description: Stomp, 1 measure: kick and snare together on every beat, snare pickup on 4& 4a, closed hat on 1-3, clap on 4 and 4&; cowbell on 4& and crash on 4 every 8 passes.

patterns.name: Dembow
patterns.description: Dancehall dembow, 1 measure: kick on every beat, snare in a 3-3-2 figure (1, 1a, 2&, 3, 3a, 4&), 16th closed hats, open hat on each &.

patterns.name: Boom Bap
patterns.description: Boom bap, 1 measure: kick on 1, 1&, 2&, 3& and 3a, snare on 2, 2a, 3e and 4e, 8th hats with 32nd figures every 3 to 6 passes, open hat on each &; clap rolls on 2 and 4 every 2 and 4 passes.

patterns.name: Funk
patterns.description: Funk, 1 measure: kick on 1, 3& and 4a every 4 passes, snare on 2, 2a, 3e and 4 with ghost fills on 4e-&-a, clap on every beat, 8th hats; crash on 4& every 6.

patterns.name: Funk Slow
patterns.description: Slow funk, 2 measures: syncopated kick with soft ghosts, snare on 4e, 6& and 8e, clap on 2, 3e, 3a, 4, 6, 7e and 8, broken 8th and 16th hats; snare fill on 8 every 4 passes.

patterns.name: Funk Fill
patterns.description: Funk fill, 1 measure: kick thickening from quarters to 16ths across the measure, snare on 2, 3, 4, 4& and 4a, quarter hats, toms on every &; 16th clap fill from 2& every 6 passes.

patterns.name: Hip-Hop
patterns.description: Hip-hop, 2 measures: kick on 1a, 2& and 3&, snare on 2 and 4 with a 4& 4a pickup at the end, swung 16th hats, open hat on each a, clap on 2e and around 4.

patterns.name: Electro
patterns.description: Electro, 1 measure: kick on every beat with soft 2& and 4&, snare on 2 and 4, syncopated closed and open hats; 16th clap figures from 2e every 3 passes.

patterns.name: House
patterns.description: House, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, snare and swung clap on 2 and 4, closed hats on 1, e and a, open hat on each &; 32nd snare roll on 4 and 16th cowbell every 3 to 8 passes.

patterns.name: House Upbeat
patterns.description: House, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, clap on every &, open hats on each e and a, tom on 2 and 4, closed-hat pickups on 2& and 4; cowbell and crash accents every 4 to 8 passes.

patterns.name: Dance
patterns.description: Dance, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, clap on 2 and 4, open hat on each &, snare on 1e and 4a, sparse closed hats; tom pickups on 4 every 6 passes.

patterns.name: Rock Variations
patterns.description: Rock, 1 measure: kick on 1 and 3&, snare on 2 and 4 with ghosts on 2& and 3e every 2 passes, 8th hats; tom, open hat, cowbell, crash and a 16th clap fill every 4 to 16 passes.

patterns.name: Trap Half-Time
patterns.description: Trap with a half-time snare on 3, 1 measure: kick on 1 and 2& with a roll on 3& every 2 passes, clap with the snare, 8th hats with 16th rolls on 3 and 4, open hat and crash on 4&; tom roll every 8 passes.

patterns.name: Rock Open Hats
patterns.description: Rock, 1 measure: kick on 1, 3 and 3&, snare on 2 with ghosts on 2a, 4 and 4a, 8th open hats and no closed hat; cowbell on 4& 4a every 6 passes, crash every 8.

patterns.name: Swing 16ths
patterns.description: Swung 16ths, 1 measure: kick on 1, 2&, 3 and 4&, snare and clap together on 1& and 2e of every 2 beats, 16th open hats, closed hat every 3 beats; tom and cowbell figures every 2 to 8 passes.

patterns.name: Melodic Toms
patterns.description: Pitched toms, 1 measure: toms rising 3, 5 and 7 semitones on 2-4 with a 5-hit ruff on 1, syncopated kick on a 32nd grid, snare on 2 and 4, closed and open hats together on every beat.

patterns.name: Disco Groove
patterns.description: Disco groove, 2 measures: four-on-the-floor kick, snare on every & doubled to &-a at the end of measure 1, 16th hats, open hat on each &, clap on 1 and 3, syncopated cowbell, 16th toms through measure 2.

patterns.name: Dub Roots
patterns.description: Dub roots, 4 measures: kick on 1 and 2&, snare on 3, closed hat on 2 and 4, open hat on 4&, low pitched hat line, delayed congas, cowbell, rim and hits, blues arpeggio on the second hit track, rimshots on 4 and 4a.

patterns.name: Feature Demo
patterns.description: Feature demo, 1 measure: kick on every beat with pickups, snare on every & with doubles, probability-gated toms and claps, cowbell arpeggios, 8th hats, open hat on each e, piano on every beat.

patterns.name: Rock Phrase A
patterns.description: Rock, 4 measures (1-4 of an 8-measure phrase): kick on 1, 3 and 3&, snare on 2 and 4, 8th hats, open hat on 4& of measures 2 and 4, crash on the first downbeat.

patterns.name: Rock Phrase B
patterns.description: Rock, 4 measures (5-8 of the phrase): the Rock Phrase A groove, then a stop on 1-2 of measure 8 with crash and kick, 16th snare on 3 and toms on 4.

patterns.name: Techno
patterns.description: Techno, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, open hat on each &, 16th closed hats around it, clap on 2 and 4, syncopated rimshots on 1a, 2&, 3a and 4e; crash every 8 passes.

patterns.name: Drum and Bass
patterns.description: Drum and bass two-step, 1 measure: kick on 1 and 3&, snare on 2 and 4 with soft ghosts on 2a and 4a, 8th hats, open hat on 4&; extra kick on 3a every 4 passes, crash every 8.

patterns.name: Reggae One Drop
patterns.description: Reggae one drop, 1 measure: kick and cross-stick together on 3 only, nothing on 1, swung 8th hats accented on the &, open hat on 4& every 4 passes; snare fill on 4e, 4& and 4a every 8.

patterns.name: Jazz Swing
patterns.description: Jazz swing on a triplet grid, 1 measure: ride on 1, 2, the last triplet of 2, 3, 4 and the last triplet of 4, hi-hat foot on 2 and 4, feathered kick on every beat, snare comping on the last triplets every 2 to 4 passes.

patterns.name: Waltz
patterns.description: Waltz in 3/4, 1 measure: kick on 1, closed hat and soft snare on 2 and 3, open hat on 3 every 2 passes; tom pickup on 3& every 4 passes, crash on 1 every 8.

patterns.name: Blues 12/8
patterns.description: Slow blues in 12/8, 1 measure: closed hats on every triplet accented on the beat, kick on 1, the last triplet of 2 and 3, snare on 2 and 4; triplet tom fill on 4 every 4 passes, crash on 1 every 8.

patterns.name: Break Roller
patterns.description: Breakbeat, 2 measures: syncopated kick, snare on 2 and 4 with probability ghosts, 16th hats looping every 3 steps against the beat, open hat every 6 steps, flammed snare on 4 of measure 2; 32nd snare roll every 2 passes, descending tom arpeggio every 4, swept high-pass on the hats.

patterns.name: Break Euclid
patterns.description: Breakbeat, 1 measure: euclidean kick (3 pulses over 1, 1a and 2&) then 3&, snare on 2 and 4 with a 64th stutter on 4a every 2 passes, 16th hats gated by probability, rimshot every 5 steps and open hat every 7 across the measure, pitched euclidean toms (5 of 16), 16th clap burst on 2 every 4 passes.

patterns.name: Techno Polymeter
patterns.description: Techno, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, clap on 2 and 4, open hat on each &, closed hats accented every 3 steps, rimshot every 5 steps with a dotted-8th delay, tom every 7 steps drifting in pitch on an LFO; high-pass on the hats swept over 4 measures, crash every 16 passes.

patterns.name: Techno Rumble
patterns.description: Techno, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick in a hall, a low-passed reverb kick on every e, & and a for the rumble with its cutoff on a slow LFO, clap on 2 and 4 with a dotted-8th delay, 16th hats gated by probability, ride on each &; 32nd snare roll on 4 every 8 passes, crash every 8.

patterns.name: Techno Acid
patterns.description: Acid techno, 1 measure: four-on-the-floor kick, clap on 2 and 4, open hat on each &, 16th hats gated by probability, synth bass arpeggio (0, 3, 7, 10, 12 up and down) on a 7-of-16 euclidean rhythm through a resonant low-pass swept over 4 measures, euclidean cowbell (3 of 8); snare build from 16ths to 32nds on 4 every 8 passes.
